name: SpirePilot AI 领航员
author: SpirePilot contributors
description: Let an AI (any OpenAI-compatible API or Claude) play Slay the Spire 2: reads the full game state, plays cards, picks routes and rewards, and talks with co-op teammates. 让 AI 读取游戏状态并操作，可控制路线、限定角色，并在多人模式中与队友沟通（要药水 / 要减益 / 问队友要不要药水）。
